integrity: Proof uses exact two-point-cover duality, the matching-cover equality in bipartite graphs, and a classification of odd cycles under matching-number two. Two Python checks confirm only finite cases. No external audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary domination only in KG(n,2) for labeled n>=5; not all dominating sets or any higher-rank Kneser graph. Existing membership criteria may entail this theorem after further analysis; literature priority remains provisional.
title: All inclusion-minimal dominating sets of the rank-two Kneser graphs
